messages:
Alex: Hey all  shipping my first change (small metric + unit test) and want to follow team norms. Quick checklist: branch naming, target branch, who to CC for runtime changes, and any local steps to avoid noisy CI?

Nora: Welcome Alex! Branch off `main`. Naming convention we prefer: `team/short-desc` for tiny fixes (e.g. `infra/add-kv-metric`) or `feature/TEAM-####-short` for tracked work. Use lowercase and hyphens.

Jamir: Target `main` unless a release manager asks for a stable-branch backport. For reviewers: check CODEOWNERS first. For runtime/serving touchpoints, add @Mira and @Jamir. If you touch docs, add @Nora.

Mira: Local sanity checks: `make lint` then `pytest tests/ -k fast` (or `./scripts/test.sh unit`). If you change API surface, run `./scripts/integration_local.sh` but you can skip long GPU suites for small logic fixes.

Alex: What's our preferred merge style? Squash?

Nora: Squash + conventional commit for the final message. Use `fix(runtime): short desc` or `feat(runtime): ...` depending on change. Keep PRs small and focused.

Jamir: Review checklist I use: 1) Does this change affect latency/memory? If yes, add `runtime-impact` label. 2) Are there unit tests or a short note why not? 3) Is behavior backwards compatible? 4) Is telemetry/metric name stable? If it's new, include a one-line description for observability.

Alex: Any PR body template I should copy into the description?

Mira: Short template we've used: paste this in your description so reviewers can skim.

```
Summary: one-line
Motivation: why this matters
Change: bullet list
Testing: local steps + CI notes
Rollout: how to canary / what to watch (metrics, logs)
Backport: yes/no
```

Jamir: CI tips: if a CI job flakes, mention @ci-bot and include the failing job name. For lint/flake8 issues, `make lint` usually reproduces locally. If GH Actions shows `unit-matrix:python3.9` failing, run `./scripts/ci_local_retry.sh unit-matrix:python3.9` as a repro.

ci-bot: note: to re-run a single job locally use `./scripts/ci_local_retry.sh <job>`; to re-run in GH Actions, click "Re-run jobs" on the workflow run. Tag me for quick retry.

Nora: Small etiquette: keep diffs under ~300 lines for quicker approvals, include an example command to reproduce if relevant, and label `release-note: none` for internal-only changes.

Alex: This is great  I'll branch as `infra/add-kv-metric`, run lint+fast tests, include the template, and ping @Mira + @Jamir. Thanks team! :rocket:
